title: Bahmut
summary: Bahmut is a commune located in the Călărași District of Moldova, comprising two villages: Bahmut and Bahmut station. Its geographical and cultural context is relevant to the broader region, including Ukraine.

sections.heading: Geographical Location
paragraphs: Bahmut is situated in the Călărași District of Moldova, which is significant in understanding the area's regional dynamics and its proximity to [[ukraine|Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Composition
paragraphs: The commune consists of two distinct villages: Bahmut and Bahmut station, which together constitute the local administrative unit.

sections.heading: Cultural Context
paragraphs: The commune of Bahmut, while located in Moldova, shares cultural and historical ties with Ukraine, reflecting the interconnectedness of the communities in this part of [[eastern-europe|Eastern Europe]].
